transform.kind: trained M3 MLP projector 2048->512->1536 ReLU (ADR-024 frozen architecture)
transform.variant: (ii) pooled-in/pooled-out: sender per-token states mean-pooled first (run-1 pipeline shape), then the SAME per-token-trained MLP on the pooled vector (ADR-024 authorial choice: shared weights; off-distribution confound disclosed in ADR-024)

config.zerovec_gate: pre-committed: pass iff 2 x zerovec accuracy >= baseline accuracy; numbers reported either way
